head: Synchronus 91 organ app for iPad and iPhone: tonewheel organ without samples
dek: Synchronus 91 is a 12.99 dollar organ app for iPad and iPhone that models a classic 91-tonewheel console organ and a rotary speaker in real time instead of playing recordings. Out since 6 November, it was #45 among paid Music apps on the US App Store on 25 November.
details: It runs on its own or as an AUv3 instrument in apps such as GarageBand, Logic Pro for iPad and AUM. It includes spring reverb, a tube preamp, drawbars on screen and ready-made settings for many drawbar MIDI controllers, plus MIDI Learn. It's a one-time purchase with no subscription or account and works offline. The maker is Abel Boquera.
where: iPad and iPhone, 12.99 dollars, out since 6 November
means: If you play keys and want an organ sound in GarageBand or on stage from an iPad, this is a single purchase.
todo: Check the listing for your MIDI controller before buying.
